description: Reusable operations pack for turning incoming work into executable task cards and maintaining deterministic shared and per-owner queues.

rules.reason: The operator needs to create, triage, assign, prioritize, complete, or archive tasks.

interface.short_description: Create, assign, and rank executable tasks.
interface.long_description: Turns raw requests into consistent task cards, verifies readiness and role assignments, and maintains deterministic global and per-owner execution order without losing completion history.
interface.default_prompt: Create these tasks, assign the required fields, verify readiness, and update the execution order.
